blocks.intro: Most toilet problems are simple repairs. A few mean it's time for a new one:

tiles.body: A worn flapper, fill valve or float wastes water all day. Usually a quick repair.
A failed wax ring or loose bolts let water leak under the toilet, which can rot the floor. Don't wait on this one.
Frequent clogs can mean an older low-flow design, a problem in the drain line, or roots further down the sewer line.
A toilet that rocks needs resetting. A cracked bowl or tank needs replacing.

blocks.h2: Toilets in Older Highland Park Homes
blocks.intro: Nearly half of Highland Park homes were built before 1960. Older bathrooms bring a few things to check when a toilet gives you trouble.

items.body: If the toilet gurgles when the washer drains, or more than one drain backs up, the clog is in the main line, not the toilet. On tree-lined lots, roots are a common cause. See [sewer rodding](/highland-park/sewer-rodding).
Replacing a toilet in an older home often means a new flange or shutoff valve too. We check both, so the new toilet sits solid and doesn't leak.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

blocks.h2: Toilet Questions From Highland Park Homeowners

items.q: Should I repair or replace my toilet?
items.preview: Most running and leaking problems are repairs. Cracks or constant clogs usually mean replacement.
items.answer: Running, leaking at the tank or a loose seat are repairs. A cracked bowl or tank, constant clogs on an old design or a toilet that no longer fits your bathroom usually mean replacing it.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.preview: Usually a worn flapper, fill valve or float. A quick repair.
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper, a fill valve that doesn't shut off or a float set too high. These are quick, inexpensive repairs.

items.q: Why does my toilet gurgle when other drains run?
items.preview: Often a main line blockage or a vent problem, not the toilet itself.
items.answer: Gurgling when the washer, tub or sink drains means air is being pulled through the toilet, often from a blockage in the main line or a venting problem. See [drain cleaning](/highland-park/drain-cleaning).

items.q: How much does toilet installation cost?
items.preview: It depends on the toilet and any flange or valve work. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the toilet, whether the flange or shutoff valve needs replacing and removal of the old one. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
